subject: Request: temporary short-cycle invoice bridge for Greenbridge
messages:
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@greenbridge.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@greenbridge.com
Date: 2026-08-01T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Request: temporary invoice cadence change for quarter-end

Hi David,

Hope you’re well — quick ask from our finance team as we close Q3. Greenbridge is moving to a consolidated payment run this quarter to align with a vendor remittance window; as a result AP is requesting a temporary move from our agreed monthly billing to a 90-day net for invoices issued between Aug 1 and Oct 31.

Our details: PO# 67321 (covers Redwood services), projected spend for period ~$137,000, single legal entity (Greenbridge Health). We can provide a short confirmation from Procurement if needed.

We understand this is non-standard; our controller asked whether Redwood could consider: 1) net-90 for invoices generated during Aug–Oct only, or 2) keeping monthly invoices but extending payment terms to net-60.

Please let us know what mitigations you’d want (deposit, milestone invoice, cap per invoice). We’d prefer a short-term exception rather than changing the master terms.

Thanks for checking — Sofia

--
Sofia Ramos
VP, Procurement | Greenbridge Health
sofia.ramos@greenbridge.com
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@greenbridge.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-01T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary invoice cadence change for quarter-end

Thanks, Sofia — appreciate the heads-up. I’ve looped in Finance and RevOps to evaluate risk and options. High-level thoughts:

- We can consider a time-bound exception but we’ll need mitigations to protect cash flow (suggestions below).
- Options we typically offer: net-60 without depositor change; or net-90 with a 20–25% upfront retainer or a per-invoice cap and monthly statements.

Would Greenbridge be open to one of these controls for Aug–Oct only? If yes, I’ll formally escalate to Deal Desk + Finance with the projected ARR and proposed controls. I attached a quick proposed schedule (proposed_schedule_v1.pdf) to speed the review.

If you can confirm preferred option (net-60 vs temporary net-90 + retainer), I’ll push for a decision today.

-David

--
David Kim
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, david.kim@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: 2026-08-01T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Greenbridge invoice cadence exception — exec approval request

Forwarding Greenbridge request and David’s note. Summary for quick review:

- Account: Greenbridge Health (Deal RG-4587)
- ARR run-rate affected: ~ $137k over the 3-month period
- Customer asks: temporary move to Net-90 for invoices issued Aug 1–Oct 31 OR net-60 extension on monthly invoices
- Proposed mitigations from Sales: 20% upfront retainer for net-90 OR net-60 w/standing monthly statement and no change to credit terms afterward

Impact model attached (impact_model.xlsx). Financial view: Net-90 increases DSO materially for the quarter; expected cash deferral ~$110k (net of retainer option). Risk: moderate (single-entity, longstanding customer, low collection history issues).

Recommendation (Deal Desk): Approve a time-limited Net-90 exception for Aug–Oct provided:
1) 25% upfront retainer posted before Aug 15,
2) Per-invoice cap of $75k (additional invoices require pre-approval),
3) Customer signs an amendment confirming reversion to standard monthly net-30 terms on Nov 1 and acceptance of a late-fee schedule if payments exceed agreed windows,
4) Finance to generate revised invoices and flag AR for weekly follow-up.

Asking Marissa/Legal for final sign-off on the conditions above (we need a quick amendment template from Legal). If approved, Sales will communicate and coordinate implementation.

-Rishi

[Attachment: impact_model.xlsx]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, david.kim@redwood.com
Cc: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@greenbridge.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T14:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Greenbridge invoice cadence exception — exec approval request

Thanks Rishi — reviewed with Finance leadership. Approval granted with the following firm, time-bound conditions:

1) Temporary Net-90 applies only to invoices issued between 2026-08-01 and 2026-10-31 (three-month window).
2) Greenbridge must post a 25% upfront retainer against anticipated charges no later than 2026-08-15.
3) Individual invoice cap of $75,000; any invoice above that requires prior written approval from Finance.
4) Customer will sign a one-page amendment confirming acceptance of these temporary terms and agreeing to revert to standard Net-30 monthly billing on 2026-11-01. Revenue will not be recognized beyond standard policy until payment is received per ASC guidance.
5) AR to run weekly reconciliations and Sales to provide a weekly topline collection update for the period.

Legal (Laura), please produce the amendment template and a short checklist for Sales to close this cleanly. David — inform Sofia of the conditions and request the retainer confirmation. Once retainer is received and amendment signed, Finance will apply the temporary terms in the billing system.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Head of Finance, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
